annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2024/1257 on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines with respect to their emissions and battery durability (Euro 7)
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/1257 on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines with respect to their emissions and battery durability (Euro 7)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Euro 7 Regulation setting type-approval requirements for cars, vans, trucks, buses and trailers on exhaust and non-exhaust emissions, battery durability, on-board monitoring, anti-tampering and cybersecurity. It bans manipulation devices, sets phased application dates, and delegates technical detail to Commission implementing and delegated acts. It contains no AI or robotics provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes Euro 7 emission limits for exhaust, brake and tyre particles across M and N vehicle categories
Requires minimum battery durability performance and state-of-health monitors for traction batteries
Prohibits manipulation devices and strategies and requires anti-tampering and cybersecurity (UN R155) measures
Mandates OBD, OBM and OBFCM systems and an Environmental Vehicle Passport
Phased application from 29 Nov 2026 (light-duty) and 29 May 2028 (heavy-duty), with repeal of Euro 5/6/VI regulations
